original_text:
–You notice that you left some skittles out on your desk when you went to bed last night. The skittles were next to your glass of water, which had created a puddle. You notice that the color and some of the inside of the skittle has dissolved into the puddle.
–Craft a line of scientific inquiry based on this observation, using the steps of the scientific method. 1.Make an Observation2.Ask a Question3.Make a Hypothesis4.Perform an Experiment(s)5.Collect and Analyze Data6.Make Conclusions
explanation: This slide presents an in-class case study task based on a real-world scenario. The observation is that leaving Skittles on a desk next to a water puddle results in the color and internal contents of the Skittles dissolving into the puddle. Students are instructed to design a scientific inquiry by applying the six steps of the scientific method: observation, question, hypothesis, experiment, data collection/analysis, and conclusions.

questions.q: What is the prompt for the in-class case study on this page?
opts: Design a system of taxonomy for candies.
Calculate the rate of dissolving using mathematical equations.
Craft a line of scientific inquiry using the steps of the scientific method based on the dissolving Skittles observation.
Dissect a Skittle to study its cellular structure.
questions.exp: The prompt asks to 'Craft a line of scientific inquiry based on this observation, using the steps of the scientific method.'
